password_reset.solution: 1. Go to System Settings > Users & Groups. 2. Click on the user account. 3. Click 'Reset Password'. 4. If locked out of Mac, restart holding Cmd+R to enter Recovery Mode and reset from there. 5. For network accounts, reset via Active Directory or contact senior IT.

printer.solution: 1. Check printer is powered on and connected to network. 2. On Mac: System Settings > Printers & Scanners > Delete printer and re-add. 3. Check paper and ink levels. 4. Restart print spooler if Windows. 5. Check Jamf Pro for printer policy deployment.

new_starter.solution: 1. Confirm start date and department with HR. 2. Create user account in Active Directory/Azure AD. 3. Enrol device in Jamf Pro. 4. Install required software via Jamf policy. 5. Send welcome email with credentials and IT guide.

video_conferencing.solution: 1. Check internet connection. 2. Quit and restart Zoom/Teams. 3. Check camera and microphone permissions: System Settings > Privacy & Security. 4. Update Zoom/Teams to latest version. 5. If persists, reinstall application.

network.solution: 1. Restart WiFi: turn off and on in menu bar. 2. Forget network and reconnect. 3. Check if issue is device-specific or affects others. 4. Restart network adapter. 5. Contact network team if building-wide issue.
